question: When AI labs say their systems are safe, what proof should the public be able to see?
reflection: Open questions asked in public can turn private promises into shared responsibility, which helps new technology serve everyone.

sources.subject: Mistral Large 4 1T params beats closed models, $1.18/M out
Claude plans may pack 5x the value

one_line: City lawmakers question AI labs on safety under oath, while Europe gets its largest open model yet and AI moves inside everyday office files.

top_stories.title: New York City Council questions AI labs on safety
top_stories.what: Former staff of leading AI labs told the New York City Council that companies cannot yet control their strongest systems, as the council weighs whistleblower protection and independent safety checks.
top_stories.why: Local rules on audits and whistleblowers could become templates elsewhere, raising demand for independent evaluation expertise.

top_stories.title: Mistral previews a trillion-parameter open model
top_stories.what: Mistral opened a preview of Mistral Large 4, which uses only a fraction of its size per word, reads images and text, supports over 160 languages, and is due to ship open weights by the end of October.
top_stories.why: A strong open model with wide language support is a candidate for local Arabic research tools that keep data in-house.

top_stories.title: Claude moves into Google Docs, Sheets and Slides
top_stories.what: Anthropic released a beta add-on that puts Claude inside Google files, where it can edit text, build formulas and slides, and propose larger changes as suggestions to accept.
top_stories.why: AI inside familiar office tools lowers the barrier for analysts, so teams need simple rules on review and data sharing.

saudi_lens.text: Google's long-term nuclear power deal shows how electricity supply now drives AI expansion, a lesson for Saudi data-centre plans built on solar and gas.

idea.title: Independent AI safety check service
idea.pitch: Offer structured, independent testing of AI tools that public bodies plan to deploy, covering bias, errors and user understanding.
idea.first_step: Draft a one-page checklist of behavioural and accuracy tests for a citizen-facing chatbot.

idea_kids.title: Ask the builder role play
idea_kids.pitch: A classroom role play where one group builds a paper machine and the other group asks questions to decide if it is safe to use.
idea_kids.first_step: Write ten simple safety questions children can ask about any machine.
